name: Omimai
source:
Satoru visits his good friend Katsura, who caught a cold.
Delirious from fever, Katsura sexually appeals to him.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064309.html]DLsite English[/url]]

悟去探望感冒了的好友桂。因发烧而神志不清的桂向他发出了性暗示。
